A '''unidentified smuggler''' worked for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. This smuggler was paid by his boss to transport the [[Noetikon of Light]] off world inside his body, but [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Maer (doctor)|Maer]] discovered this smuggling ring. With the help of a [[The Barsen'thor|young Jedi Consular]], he prevented the Noetikon from getting off world.
